Vivek Enterprises

Interior turnkey contracting company

Turnkey Interior Contracting

We have the resources and capability to set up your office from scratch. To be more elaborate, our solutions cover the design and execution of civil works & furniture, interior designing, HVAC, electrical works, fire protection/alarm systems, access control, LAN and data cabling, electronic surveillance and Video Conferencing Equipment installations. We Provide one Stop Solution for all interior related Activities

Testimonial

Vivek Enterprises formed by Mr. Vijay Vishwakarma has a wide range of Experience in interior Contracting. He also is a chief Promoter, having an Aspiring team with the sole intention of providing Good Interior Services to the Client. The company was formed in 2004 and from there we have Witnessed Unparallel growth in the Interior industry.

About Us

We, Vivek Enterprises,  situated in Thane West, Maharashtra. Operates primarily in the fields of architecture and interior designing with a talented team of designers. We have successfully conceptualized and completed the interior designs of numerous residential, and commercial projects as well as architectural projects. We have completed some of the finest designs with the help of our renowned designers
